title: MEMORY IS NOT OWNERSHIP; MESSAGE IS NOT COMMAND
thesis: A free actor needs memory and communication, but those powers become coercive if remembering silently means owning canonical reality or if speaking silently means commanding another node.

epistemic_boundary.observable_statement: The environment offered distinct memory and communication affordances, and the capability fabric recorded typed use, refusal, replay, or uncertainty without collapsing those affordances into world or peer control.

canonical_sentence: THE THIRD WISH GIVES JANUS A MEMORY THAT CANNOT OWN THE WORLD AND A VOICE THAT CANNOT OWN THE LISTENER.
next_semantic_question: Can JANUS sense and affect physical or model-mediated environments while preserving the same distinction between observation, request, authority and irreversible effect?
